description: This pie chart visually represents the distribution of different relational association types within the MMRA benchmark, with each slice corresponding to a specific category and its count and percentage of the total. The chart contains ten distinct slices, each labeled with its category name, count, and percentage. The largest slice is “ObservationAngle” with 126 instances (12.28%), followed by “SimilarMaterial” with 106 instances (10.33%), “SubEvent” with 100 instances (9.74%), and “UsageSimilarity” with 100 instances (9.65%). Other categories include “NearSameEntity” (63, 6.34%), “RelativePosition” (81, 7.90%), “MentalitySimilarity” (89, 8.67%), “SimilarEvent” (90, 8.77%), “AppearanceSimilarity” (90, 8.77%), “Environment” (90, 8.77%), and “Layout” (90, 8.77%). Each slice is colored differently and includes its label and percentage directly on the chart, with no legend or exploded slices, and the segments are arranged in descending order of size.
